assistant.primaryUsageNote: 반말: what you actually say to a close friend. For the 해요체 version use Casual mode; for professional settings use Professional mode.

alternativeTranslations.note: Loanword from English "thank you": playful, between close friends. Very common in chat.
Abbreviation of 감사 used in texts/DMs. Only in writing, never spoken.
개- prefix amplifies like "super/fucking": "super thanks". Only with close friends.
Clipped form often used in chat: feels casual and warm.

senses.definition: A short, informal expression of gratitude.

assistant.etymology: From Middle English thankes, from Old English þancas, plural of þanc "thought, gratitude."
assistant.notes: In friend-to-friend Korean, 고마워 is the baseline; younger speakers often mix in 땡큐, ㄱㅅ (text), or prefix 개- for emphasis. Avoid 요-endings entirely in this register. ㄱㅅ is the chat abbreviation of 감사 (gratitude): text-only and feels playful.
